key.name: speed
key.description:
A multiplier on the rate every shell animation advances at. 1.0 is the designed speed, 0.5 runs everything at half speed, 2.0 at double.
This scales time, not durations: a spring keeps its shape and an easing curve its curve, they just play slower or faster. Animations already running when the value changes finish on the rate they started with.
It cannot reach zero — that is a frozen clock, not a slow one. To turn animations off, use org.gnome.desktop.interface enable-animations.
